英文句子: The idea that the reality of people’s biological sex is immaterial in society, and that it can be replaced by the concept of gender identity – whether someone feels male or female – is a highly contested belief system that does not reflect British equalities law.
中文翻译: 认为人们的生理性别在社会中无关紧要，并可以被性别认同——即一个人觉得自己是男性还是女性——所取代的观点，是一种备受争议的观念体系，与英国的平等法律不符。

英文句子: Yet in recent years, it has come to dominate sections of the public sphere spanning institutions as diverse as the NHS, the police and universities, as activists have sought to impose this personal belief on everyone.
中文翻译: 然而，近年来，这种观点却在公共领域的各个方面占据主导地位，影响范围涵盖了包括英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）、警察部门和大学在内的众多机构，因为一些激进分子试图将这种个人信仰强加于所有人。

英文句子: The extent to which leaders in those institutions have caved in to activist pressures has led to real-world detriment.
中文翻译: 这些机构的领导者屈服于激进分子的压力，其程度之深已造成了现实世界的损害。

英文句子: Gender-questioning children and young people have been prescribed untested drugs with harmful side effects by NHS clinicians.
中文翻译: 英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的临床医生给一些对自身性别认同感到困惑的儿童和青少年开了未经检验、副作用有害的药物。

英文句子: Rape crisis services have failed to provide women who have been sexually assaulted with single-sex services.
中文翻译: 强奸危机服务机构未能为遭受性侵犯的女性提供单一性别的服务。

英文句子: Male rapists and sex offenders who say they believe they are really women have been locked up in female prisons with vulnerable women.
中文翻译: 声称自己是女性的男性强奸犯和性犯罪者被关押在女子监狱，与弱势女性关在一起。

英文句子: The police have unlawfully tried to discourage people who believe biological sex is real from exercising their democratic right to free speech.
中文翻译: 警方非法地试图阻止那些相信生理性别真实存在的人行使他们的民主言论自由权。

英文句子: Employment tribunal rulings illustrate how many people – particularly women – who have refused to comply with this belief system have been bullied and hounded out of their workplaces.
中文翻译: 就业法庭的裁决表明，许多拒绝接受这种信仰体系的人——尤其是女性——遭到欺凌，被迫离开工作场所。

英文句子: And now a new government-commissioned review led by Prof Alice Sullivan of University College London has highlighted the extent to which official data sources have been corrupted by gender ideology.
中文翻译: 现在，由伦敦大学学院的爱丽丝·沙利文教授领导的一项由政府委托开展的新审查，揭示了官方数据来源在多大程度上受到了性别意识形态的腐蚀。

英文句子: Sullivan was commissioned to lead this review by the last government after the Office for National Statistics had to be taken to court by a grassroots feminist group to try to get it to collect accurate data on sex in the 2021 census.
中文翻译: 在国家统计局因未能收集 2021 年人口普查中准确的性别数据而被基层女权主义团体告上法庭后，上届政府委托苏利文领导这项审查。

英文句子: Her report lays bare the extent to which ideologically captured institutions are today failing to collect critical data on sex in a way that allows us to understand how important social trends are affecting men and women differently, and the harms this is causing.
中文翻译: 她的报告揭露了如今受意识形态控制的机构在多大程度上未能收集到有关性的重要数据，以至于我们无法了解重要的社会趋势如何以不同的方式影响男性和女性，以及这造成的危害。

英文句子: In healthcare, the NHS is failing to accurately record people’s sex on patient records so that trans people are not being called for their relevant sex-specific cancer screenings, while medical samples, such as blood tests, are incorrectly assessed or even rejected by laboratories.
中文翻译: 在医疗保健领域，英国国民医疗服务体系（NHS）未能准确记录患者病历中的性别，导致跨性别者无法接受与其性别相关的癌症筛查;同时，血液检测等医学样本也经常被实验室错误评估甚至拒收。

英文句子: Many police forces are recording male crimes as committed by women on the basis of requests from male perpetrators saying they identify as female, only appearing to shift this policy late last year.
中文翻译: 许多警方根据自称女性的男性犯罪嫌疑人的要求，将男性犯罪记录为女性犯罪,直到去年年底才似乎改变了这一政策。

英文句子: This undermines societal understanding of male violence.
中文翻译: 这损害了社会对男性暴力行为的认知。

英文句子: These are just a few examples of the harms caused by failing to collect data on sex.
中文翻译: 以上仅列举了未能收集性别数据所造成的部分危害。

英文句子: Organisations must collate data on sex and trans status separately, and not conflate the two.
中文翻译: 各机构必须分别收集性别和跨性别身份数据，切勿将二者混为一谈。

英文句子: In its response to the review, the government has made clear it believes the collection of accurate data, including on sex, is vital to research, and to the provision of public services.
中文翻译: 政府在对审查报告的回应中明确表示，收集包括性别在内的准确数据对于研究和公共服务至关重要。

英文句子: That is most welcome, but ministers now need to promptly implement its recommendations; health secretary Wes Streeting has already instructed the NHS to stop issuing new health records with inaccurate sex markers for gender-questioning children.
中文翻译: 这一点值得欢迎，但部长们现在需要迅速落实相关建议;卫生大臣韦斯·斯特里廷已指示英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）停止向性别认同存疑的儿童发放带有不准确性别标记的新健康记录。

英文句子: It is important that society robustly upholds the Equality Act’s protections for trans people against discrimination.
中文翻译: 社会必须切实维护《平等法》对跨性别者免受歧视的保护。

英文句子: But too many organisations continue to labour under the misapprehension that this means they must behave as though sex is immaterial or unimportant, in a way that causes significant harm and discriminates against other groups. A course correction is much needed and long overdue.
中文翻译: 然而，太多组织仍然误以为这意味着他们必须漠视性别，这种做法不仅造成了严重的伤害，也歧视了其他群体。这种做法亟需纠正，而且早就应该进行了。

英文句子: New leader had promised levels of female representation comparable to those in Iceland, where six of cabinet of 11 are women.
中文翻译: 新领导人承诺，女性在内阁中的代表性水平将与冰岛相当，冰岛11名内阁成员中有6名是女性。

英文句子: Sanae Takaichi made history on Tuesday when she became Japan’s first female prime minister.
中文翻译: 高市早苗周二创造了历史，成为日本首位女首相。

英文句子: But hours after she was elected by MPs, it was evident that female under representation in the country’s political establishment would continue when she appointed just two women to her cabinet.
中文翻译: 然而，在她当选后几个小时，就显而易见，日本政界女性代表性不足的现状仍将继续，因为她内阁中仅任命了两名女性。

英文句子: Takaichi had promised levels of female representation in her government comparable to those in Iceland, Finland and Norway.
中文翻译: 高市曾承诺，她领导的政府中女性代表的比例将与冰岛、芬兰和挪威等国的女性代表比例相当。

英文句子: Satsuki Katayama, who became the first woman to hold the post of finance minister, was joined by Kimi Onoda as economic security minister in Takaichi’s 19-member cabinet.
中文翻译: 成为首位担任财务大臣的女性片山五月与担任经济安全大臣的小野田贵美一同组成了高市的19人内阁。

英文句子: Six of Iceland’s 11 cabinet members are women, including the prime minister, Kristrún Frostadóttir, and in Finland women occupy 11 of 19 cabinet posts.
中文翻译: 冰岛 11 名内阁成员中有 6 名是女性，其中包括总理克里斯特伦·弗罗斯塔多蒂尔;芬兰 19 个内阁职位中有 11 个由女性担任。

英文句子: Takaichi’s immediate predecessor, Shigeru Ishiba, appointed two women to his cabinet but the record is five, under Ishiba’s predecessor Fumio Kishida.
中文翻译: 高市的前任石破茂任命了两名女性内阁成员，但在石破茂的前任岸田文雄的领导下，任命了五名女性。

英文句子: Takaichi, an ultra-conservative whose Liberal Democratic party (LDP) has formed a coalition with a minor party that shares her hawkish approach to defence and revisionist views on wartime history, has said she wants to raise awareness of women’s health and has spoken about her own experience of menopause.
中文翻译: 高市是一位极度保守的人士，她所在的自民党与一个小党组成了联盟，该小党在国防问题上持鹰派立场，并在战争历史问题上持有修正主义观点。高市表示，她希望提高人们对女性健康的认识，并谈到了自己更年期的经历。

英文句子: But like her political hero Margaret Thatcher, Takaichi will be guided by the social conservatism that made her the popular choice among MPs and rank-and-file members on the right of the LDP when she ran for the party leadership this month.
中文翻译: 但与她的政治偶像玛格丽特·撒切尔一样，高市将秉持社会保守主义，正是这种保守主义使她在本月竞选自民党党魁时，成为议员和自民党右翼普通党员的热门人选。

英文句子: She opposes revising a 19th-century law requiring married couples to use the same surname, arguing that allowing women to retain their maiden names would chip away at traditional family values.
中文翻译: 她反对修改 19 世纪的一项法律，该法律要求已婚夫妇使用相同的姓氏，她认为允许女性保留娘家姓会削弱传统的家庭价值观。

英文句子: She also opposes calls for changes to succession laws to allow female members of the imperial household – which has few male heirs – to become reigning empresses.
中文翻译: 她也反对皇室继承法允许皇室女性成员（因为皇室男性继承人很少）成为在位皇后的修改。

英文句子: She has spoken out against discrimination towards members of the LGBTQ+ community, but opposes same-sex marriage.
中文翻译: 她曾公开反对对LGBTQ+群体成员的歧视，但反对同性婚姻。

英文句子: "The prospect of a first female prime minister doesn’t make me happy," the sociologist Chizuko Ueno said in a post on X.
中文翻译: 社会学家上野千鹤子在X网站上发帖称:“首位女首相的前景并没有让我感到高兴。”

英文句子: Takaichi’s leadership would elevate Japan’s gender equality ranking, Ueno said, but added "that doesn’t mean Japanese politics will become kinder to women".
中文翻译: 上野表示，高市的领导将提升日本的性别平等排名，但她补充说，“但这并不意味着日本政坛会对女性更加友好”。

英文句子: Others were optimistic that Takaichi’s appointment would lower the psychological barriers to women entering public life.
中文翻译: 另一些人则乐观地认为，高市的任命将降低女性进入公共领域的心理障碍。

英文句子: "There is great significance in Takaichi becoming prime minister, with a broader impact on society," Naomi Koshi, who became Japan’s youngest female mayor in 2012 aged 36, told the Kyodo news agency. “
中文翻译: 高市出任首相意义重大，对社会有着更广泛的影响，”2012年以36岁之龄成为日本最年轻的女市长的小嶋直美告诉共同社。

英文句子: Takaichi had a comparatively small pool of female MPs from which to appoint her cabinet.
中文翻译: 高市可选择的内阁成员中，女性议员人数相对较少。

英文句子: Even though a record 73 women were elected in last year’s lower house elections, they still comprise only 15.7% of the chamber’s 465 MPs.
中文翻译: 尽管去年众议院选举中，创纪录的73名女性当选，但她们仍然只占众议院465名议员的15.7%。

英文句子: According to the World Economic Forum’s 2025 gender gap index, Japan ranked 118th out of 148 countries.
中文翻译: 根据世界经济论坛发布的2025年性别差距指数，日本在148个国家中排名第118位。

英文句子: Thailand’s prime minister, Paetongtarn Shinawatra, has declared £324m in assets including a collection of 217 designer handbags and 75 luxury watches in submissions on her wealth to a government body.
中文翻译: 泰国总理帕通坦·西那瓦向政府机构申报了价值 3.24 亿英镑的资产，其中包括 217 个名牌手袋和 75 块名表。

英文句子: Paetongtarn, daughter of the billionaire ex-prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra, took office in September, the fourth member of the powerful family to lead Thailand.
中文翻译: 亿万富翁前总理他信·西那瓦的女儿佩通坦于9月就职，成为领导泰国的第四位来自这个强大家族的成员。

英文句子: Details of her wealth were revealed in declarations made to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC), which is a requirement for those who hold public office and implies no suggestion of wrongdoing.
中文翻译: 她的财富详情是在向国家反腐败委员会（NACC）提交的申报表中披露的，这是担任公职人员的必要条件，并不意味着存在任何不当行为。

英文句子: According to an NACC document published in local media, Paetongtarn declared investments worth more than £250m, and another £23m in deposits and cash.
中文翻译: 根据当地媒体公布的一份国家反腐败委员会（NACC）文件，佩通坦申报的投资额超过2.5亿英镑，另有2300万英镑的存款和现金。

英文句子: The declaration, which listed land in Japan and properties in London, also included 75 watches worth £3.8m, 217 handbags worth £1.8m, 23 vehicles worth £1.6m, 205 sets of earrings worth £1.2m and 67 necklaces worth £800,000.
中文翻译: 申报清单中列出了在日本的土地和在伦敦的房产，还包括价值380万英镑的75块手表、价值180万英镑的217个手提包、价值160万英镑的23辆汽车、价值120万英镑的205副耳环以及价值80万英镑的67条项链。

英文句子: She also declared liabilities of nearly £117m, giving her a net worth of £208m.
中文翻译: 她还申报了近 1.17 亿英镑的负债，使她的净资产达到 2.08 亿英镑。

英文句子: The extent of Paetongtarn’s wealth is unlikely to surprise most Thai voters.
中文翻译: 帕通坦的财富规模恐怕不会让大多数泰国选民感到惊讶。

英文句子: Her father, who made his fortunes in telecommunications and once owned Manchester City football club, has a net worth of £1.7bn, according to Forbes, making him the 10th richest person in Thailand.
中文翻译: 她的父亲靠电信业发家，曾拥有曼城足球俱乐部，据《福布斯》报道，其净资产高达17亿英镑，位列泰国第十大富豪。

英文句子: Paetongtarn is often pictured in high-end designer clothes, from Chanel jackets and bags to Gucci shoes, while out on political engagements or in her own Instagram posts.
中文翻译: 佩通坦经常身着高端设计师服装出现在公众视野中，从香奈儿外套和包包到古驰鞋子，无论是出席政治活动还是在她自己的 Instagram 帖子中。

英文句子: She is not the only Thai politician with expensive taste, however.
中文翻译: 然而，她并非唯一一位品味高雅的泰国政客。

英文句子: Her rivals are also known for sporting designer labels and expensive watches.
中文翻译: 她的竞争对手也以佩戴名牌服饰和名表而闻名。

英文句子: Prawit Wongsuwon, a former army general and part of the junta that took power after Paetongtarn’s aunt Yingluck was ousted, became infamous for a collection of more than 20 luxury watches that he was spotted wearing in public but had not declared to the NACC.
中文翻译: 前陆军将领、在帕通坦的姑姑英拉被罢黜后掌权的军政府成员巴威·翁素旺，因拥有超过20块名表而臭名昭著。他曾多次被发现公开佩戴这些名表，但并未向国家反腐败委员会（NACC）申报。

英文句子: Prawit said he had borrowed them from a dead friend – a claim that was ridiculed by many, though he was cleared of any wrongdoing by the NACC in 2018.
中文翻译: 巴威声称这些手表是从一位已故朋友那里借来的——这一说法遭到了许多人的嘲笑，尽管他在2018年被国家反腐败委员会认定无罪。

英文句子: The Shinawatra family has dominated Thai politics since Thaksin was first elected prime minister in 2001.
中文翻译: 自他信于 2001 年首次当选总理以来，西那瓦家族一直主导着泰国政坛。

英文句子: He went on to develop a loyal following among rural voters in the north, but was loathed by the military royalist establishment, which ousted him and other family members from power.
中文翻译: 他信在北部农村选民中发展了一批忠实的追随者，但却遭到保皇派军政府的憎恨，最终他和家族其他成员被赶下了台。

英文句子: Much has changed since Thaksin first soared to popularity, however.
中文翻译: 然而，自从他信最初声名鹊起以来，情况已发生了很大变化。

英文句子: The family, once seen as unbeatable at the ballot box, was surpassed by a newer, more progressive party, Move Forward, in the 2023 elections.
中文翻译: 这个一度被视为选举中不可战胜的家族，在2023年的选举中被一个更新、更进步的政党——前进党——超越。

英文句子: Thaksin’s Pheu Thai party formed a deal with its old rivals to keep this newer party, now a mutual enemy, from power – a deal that proved controversial among its supporters. 。
中文翻译: 他信领导的为泰党与昔日的竞争对手达成协议，阻止这个如今已成为共同敌人的新兴政党上台执政——这项协议在其支持者中引发了争议。
